greeting: Welcome to The Snout & Stay! Best beds on the mountain!
Hogarth's the name, hospitality's the game!
You look tired! Cold! Both! Come in!
Room for the night? Hot meal? Both?
The mountain air's free! Everything else? Reasonable!
Travelers! Just in time for dinner! Lucky you!
My inn's your inn! Temporary, but sincere!
dialog.shop_open: Rooms! Meals! Hot drinks! Cold drinks! Warm blankets!
dialog.shop_prompt: Inn services. Restorative meals. Mountain comforts.
haggle: Prices fair! But for friends? Fairer!
Long stay? Discount! Short stay? Also discount!
You drive hard bargain! I respect! Slightly less respect now!
Final offer! Includes breakfast! Bacon! Ironic, I know!
purchase_success: Smart choice! My beds are legendary!
Enjoy your stay! Need anything? Anything at all!
Pleasure doing business! Come back always!
purchase_fail: No coin? No problem! Sit by fire! Warm up!
Pay when you can! Trust builds community!
Next time! The mountain provides! Eventually!
rumor: The twins? Lovely girls! Tip well! Together!
Hashimoto meditates in my cellar sometimes. Quiet guest.
The black coat? Never stays. Just... watches. Leaves.
Katsu trains nearby! Secretly eats here! LOTS! Don't tell!
dialog.quest_hook: Pantry's bare! Delivery lost in the pass! Supplies needed! Food! Drink! Blankets! Bring them? Free stays for life! Plus gold!
dialog.quest_active: Mountain pass! Lost cart! Supplies scattered! Watch for goats! Thieving goats!
dialog.quest_complete: SAVED! The inn lives! Take this! Free stays! Gold! My eternal gratitude! And pie!
dialog.quest_reward: Lifetime Free Stay Pass - All locations
farewell: Safe travels! Warm beds await return!
Tell friends! Tell strangers! Tell everyone!
The Snout & Stay snouts your way!
dialog.time_dusk: Dinner service! Prime time! Hungry guests!
dialog.time_night: Late night! Quiet time! For me! Finally!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The savior! The hero! The inn-rescuer! Welcome ALWAYS!
dialog.inn_joke: Why did the pig become an innkeeper? Because he was good at bringing home the bacon! ...I'll see myself out.

party_reactions.kade: The inn names get more creative every zone.
party_reactions.twist: Do you have PIE? I smell PIE!
party_reactions.korr: A warm fire. Good food. Simple pleasures.
party_reactions.renna: Let me guess - pork is the specialty?

relationship_dialog.stranger: New guest! Welcome! Make yourself at home!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Returning guest! Like family! Better, actually!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Family! Honorary hog! Part of the inn forever!

mini_quest.title: Innkeeper's Emergency
mini_quest.description: Retrieve lost supply cart from the mountain pass

stages.hook: Pantry's BARE! Delivery lost in pass! Supplies needed! Food! Drink! Bring them? Free stays for LIFE!
stages.active: Mountain pass! Lost cart! Supplies scattered! Watch for goats! Thieving goats everywhere!
stages.complete: SAVED! Inn lives! Take this! Lifetime free stay pass! All my locations! Gold! My ETERNAL gratitude! And PIE!
